text:
maria_cs: Hi team — PulsePoint is launching a EU demo on Tue 2026-04-06 and asked for a temporary throughput bump + EU allowlist. Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, so we want this low-friction. Details below.
raj_ops: Can do. Need customer source IPs and expected peak QPS. Also confirm TTL for the allowlist.
maria_cs: IPs: 34.120.45.11, 34.120.45.12 (they'll originate from our partner proxy). Peak: ~60 QPS sustained for 3 hours, spikes ~120 QPS for short bursts. Request window: Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC. Autorevoke after 6h.
jess_eng: For 120 QPS spikes, recommend pinning to our L2 model variant (reduced response size) or enable KV warmup. Which model are they hitting?
maria_cs: They're on `gpt-open-3-small` via hosted API. Happy to pin to `gpt-open-3-small-lowlatency` if needed.
sam_infra: I'll open peering/ticket for EU edge routing. ETA depends on infra calendar but can do provisional allowlist + ACL changes. Need the CIDR? Is it /32 only?
maria_cs: /32 is fine, two IPs above.
marco_sre: Also recommend temporary rate window bump (token-based) rather than global account RLift. We can do a per-route soft cap to avoid affecting other customers.
liz_account: FYI renewal flagged — will run a quick 1:1 demo follow-up right after demo. This config change helps remove friction.
raj_ops: Plan: (1) Create per-route allowlist for two IPs, TTL 8h with autorevoke at 12:00 UTC, (2) Apply per-route soft QPS window to 150 for the demo window, (3) Pin to low-latency model variant and warm KV cache. I'll post the ticket numbers when created.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: infra-change/482193 -> provisional ACL add at 2026-04-06T09:00Z, rollback at 2026-04-06T13:00Z
raj_ops: Ticket created: INF-2026-4557. Applied provisional config in staging for smoke tests. Please validate.
jess_eng: Smoke test passed locally with pinned variant, KV warmed. One thing: response tokens increased 5% under pinned variant; should be fine for demo.
raj_ops: Applied to prod-now for the window. Config id: cfg_pulse_20260406_01. Autorevoke scheduled 2026-04-06T13:00Z.
maria_cs: Amazing — please DM me when live so I can tell customer. Also capture feedback in renewal notes.
raj_ops: Live now. ACL + window applied. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/inbox/INF-2026-4557
maria_cs: Shared with PulsePoint and their ops confirmed they can see reduced 504s. :tada:
liz_account: I'll log this in renewal notes and schedule the follow-up demo on 2026-04-08 15:00 UTC.
marco_sre: I'll keep an eye on error budget during the window. Flag me if you see latency above 250ms p95.
maria_cs: Thanks all. Closing the loop — great cross-team coordination. :heart:
